title: shiv registry
description: Tracks installed packages, their paths, and optional command aliases.

path.description: Absolute path to the package's repository directory.

aliases.description: Optional command aliases. Each alias gets a symlink in the bin directory.

ref.description: Current Git ref for this package (release tag, branch, exact tag, or commit SHA).

refMode.description: Update intent for the ref: release channel, branch tracking, exact tag, exact commit, or local path.
